claim: There is no spectral pair of cardinality 12 in Z/2310Z.

imported_results.name: spectral-to-tiling in Z/210Z
imported_results.use: A projected spectral 12-set would tile, impossible since 12 does not divide 210.

imported_results.name: levelwise cuboid lemma
imported_results.use: A failed Phi_(11d)-to-Phi_d descent makes a cuboid evaluation a nonzero multiple of 11.

imported_results.name: spectral mask-zero characterization
imported_results.use: Differences in either member force cyclotomic zeros of the opposite mask.

proof_map.statement: Phi_11 divides neither mask because Phi_11(1)=11 does not divide 12.
Both projections to Z/210Z are injective; a collision creates an order-11 difference and forces Phi_11 in the opposite mask.
For each mask, projected spectrality must fail, yielding d|210 with Phi_(11d) present and Phi_d absent.
The levelwise cuboid identity and 11 <= |evaluation| <= 12 force all 11 levels nonempty, hence the exact pattern (2,1^10), for both masks.
For every cross-level spectrum difference, irreducibility of Phi_11 over Q(zeta_d) forces all eleven section Fourier sums of A to be equal.
The double section is a sum of two unit phases with unit modulus, so their ratio is a primitive cube root.
Relative to a singleton spectrum level, eleven remaining phases lie in two classes; cross-level equality is forbidden and the unique double level permits at most three points.

conclusion: The hypothetical spectral pair cannot exist.
